scope.description: Version and verify the complete fail-closed P5 topology-unit membership/read-pattern adapter contract; production artifact/schema/serializer changes and full-data execution remain owned by the parent task.

assumptions: Only M2-eligible candidates with joint_signature PASS instantiate topology units; rejected candidates are census funnel outcomes, not solver abstentions.
The complete unit read set is exactly the unique block projections touching at least one unit locus; RG-only duplicate occurrences never change multiplicity.
No authoritative allele-specific CN/LOH evidence is available to this adapter, so it neither partitions reads by HP/PS nor promotes strict infinite-sites or Dollo endpoints.

step_verify.step: Build a versioned deterministic topology membership plan from candidate identities and joint-signature gates.
step_verify.verify: Positive, sorting, locale/input-order invariance and duplicate/conflict negative tests exit 0 with one frozen plan SHA-256.

step_verify.step: Adapt one instantiated membership and BlockScienceEvidence into canonical unique-read ReadPatternObservation values.
step_verify.verify: BQ, missing-call, marker-universe, R/A/O/X, partial-subcube and multiplicity=1 tests exit 0 with exact evidence/input SHA-256.

step_verify.step: Compile and replay the component under strict warnings, AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer.
step_verify.verify: Every compile and execution exits 0; the immutable receipt records exact commands, counts and output digests.

evidence.command: strict GCC release compile and C/C.UTF-8 replay; combined ASan/UBSan compile and replay; P4/P5 24-read complete-readset cross-check; governance check-state
evidence.output_excerpt: PASS plan=c50acf9d... membership=a9d11aa0... input=6263e0f0... evidence=ee619a7b...; P4/P5 readset=f9a34ec0... exact; ASan/UBSan errors=0; governance PASS.

deviations: CMakeLists.txt and tests/CMakeLists.txt were outside this child write set. Verification used exact direct C++17 compilation; parent integration must register the source and test target.

Review of the active P4 joint-signature implementation established that the upstream M1-core complete-readset and the P5 all-projection complete-R/A diagnostic have different domains. The adapter binds both but deliberately does not perform a false equality check.
LeakSanitizer was disabled for the sandbox replay; AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer remained active and reported zero errors.
